title: Pacemaker insertion
description: A pacemaker insertion is a procedure where your doctor implants a small device under your skin to regulate your heartbeat. Your doctor places it in a pouch under your collarbone and connects wires through blood vessels to your heart. The pacemaker monitors your heart's natural rhythm and delivers electrical impulses when your heart is beating too slowly (bradycardia). This life-saving device helps restore a steady, healthy heart rhythm so blood can circulate properly. The procedure is minimally invasive and performed in a cardiac electrophysiology lab. This type of procedure can be performed various ways, including temporary pacemaker and permanent pacemaker, and the cost may vary depending on the specific approach or service provided.
